audience: warehouse teams with SkuVault API tokens for an enabled integration user

useCases.title: Check stock by warehouse and location
useCases.text: Find a product, then inspect its available quantities and stock locations.

useCases.title: Review sales and inventory
useCases.text: List sales in the requested status and compare their items with warehouse stock.

useCases.title: Review purchase-order receiving
useCases.text: List purchase orders and inspect their receiving history to see what has arrived.

useCases.title: Record an inventory adjustment
useCases.text: Inspect the current item quantity, then add or remove the explicitly requested stock at the selected location. Each adjustment changes inventory and must not be blindly repeated.
